notes.text: Rautenstrauch-Joest-Museum, Inventarbuch 6, page 96 (stable citation https://doi.org/10.11588/diglit.76627#0096). The printed headings are Nr., Gegenstand, Herkunft, Erwerbung and Bemerkungen. The numbered entries appear as 32 600 and 32 602; the digits match the assigned accessions after removing the space. The Gegenstand entry at 32 600 reads 'Holzschnitzerei (Kopf)'. The final compound at 32 602 appears to read 'Tanzhandhabe'; retain the reading as uncertain. Herkunft is handwritten 'Osterinsel' for both. These are historical register descriptions, not a claim of present location or a MoSA classification. The HAI page states CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; the preserved scan is source evidence only.
